subject: Fix gossip corruption debug log to print the offending entry (#4101)
reason: The change only fixes which bytes a LL_WARNING debug log prints when a gossip entry carries an invalid node ID (g+i instead of g in verifyGossipSectionNodeIds). No reply, data, cluster-state, or control-flow behaviour changes: the invalid-ID count, the link drop, and the bounds assert are identical on both builds. The branch is reachable only via a hand-crafted or memory-corrupted cluster-bus packet, which no fuzzer component can produce (raw bytes go to the client port, not the cluster bus), and even if reached the only difference is log text that no oracle compares. A logging-only fix with n
